OIM.title: Solvay third quarter 2026 results
OIM.summary: Solvay reported Q3 2026 underlying net sales of €1,031 million, down 3.3% organically, with EBITDA margin declining to 16.8% due to Middle East conflict impacts and weakness in soda ash markets. The company signed a long-term rare earth feedstock supply agreement with Viridis and continues discussions with OneIM for a potential rare earths joint venture. Structural cost savings reached €283 million toward a €300 million target, while the board approved a stable interim dividend of €0.97 per share.
